If you play "$25, $50 or $250" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
1140.headline: What's actually left to win

696.body:
The top prize count on "Monopoly 200X" has not moved since we started watching it. The game still has two of ten top prizes unclaimed. Smaller prizes keep getting claimed as tickets sell. The same top prizes are now among fewer tickets.

The most common prize left on "Monopoly 200X" right now is $50.

Every line of Monopoly 200X's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
696.headline: Top prizes are still left

762.body:
About two-thirds of the tickets for "Billion" have been sold. The game is past the halfway point of its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

The table below shows the full count for "Billion", with every prize level included.
762.headline: Early stage or late

827.body:
"50th Anniversary" has gone over a month without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. Most of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $15 million prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

The numbers for "50th Anniversary" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
827.headline: No new top prize claims

847.body:
Before you buy "Bingo 50X", know that its $500,000 top prize is gone. The game still pays many smaller prizes, but the biggest one left is $100,000. That is a good win, but far from the advertised top prize.

Today's free summary of "Bingo 50X" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
847.headline: The advertised top prize is gone

891.body:
"Cash Explosion 25X" is near the end of its run, with only a small slice of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

Every line of Cash Explosion 25X's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
891.headline: How much has sold
